notes: Waves are a finer decomposition of the M1-M6 milestones in docs/agent-handoff.md. Those milestones remain authoritative. Milestone Inputs are read scope: an identifier may appear in several. Wave assignment is delivery scope: each identifier is owned by exactly one wave.

waves.title: Foundation: toolchain, evidence substrate and boundary policy

hard_gate.statement: public API typing direction is explicit and clean under the pinned checker

waves.title: Core domain records, diagnostics and generated schemas
YAML authoring, source mapping and semantic identity

hard_gate.statement: nested validation resolves to source location

waves.title: Arrow fabric: explicit physical schemas and interchange

hard_gate.statement: Semantic equality/hashes ignore incidental Arrow chunk layout.

waves.title: Delta persistence, SnapshotProviders and coherent releases

hard_gate.statement: Fault injection after every publication stage never exposes partial state.

waves.title: Release-scoped queries and policy-driven graph analysis

hard_gate.statement: DataFusion and NetworkX read the same release.

waves.title: Semantic change records and the operations surface

hard_gate.statement: Layout/presentation-only changes do not masquerade as semantic model changes.

waves.title: Generator foundations: Jinja, lxml and the projection artifact model

hard_gate.statement: Templates do not traverse NetworkX/DataFusion, infer relationships, select semantic view membership or fetch evidence.

waves.title: Notation generators: ArchiMate, C4, BPMN, UML and ERD

hard_gate.statement: All notation IDs trace to canonical IDs.

waves.title: Offline portal and self-contained milestone export

hard_gate.statement: No external runtime assets/network calls are required for the canonical offline bundle.

waves.title: Cross-family qualification and the vertical slice

hard_gate.statement: A synthetic vertical slice runs source -> validated model -> storage -> coherent release -> relational/graph queries -> semantic change -> standards projections -> local renders -> offline portal/export, with fault-injection and historical-replay evidence.

cross_family_placements.rationale: The typed relational core is domain modelling; CORE-04 and CORE-12 cannot be delivered without it. Listed in M1 Inputs.
Five independent status dimensions are record fields; adding them after W4 publishes immutable manifests forces a DATA-56 migration. Listed in M1 Inputs.
PROJ-23/24/27..31 in W7b cannot generate behavior, ordering or ERD keys from inferred edges. Listed in M1 Inputs.

Semantic-versus-layout digests and the four meanings of validation success are the Diagnostic category enum plus CORE-03 aliases; single-sourcing here lets PROJ-04/PROJ-07 consume rather than redefine.
Unknown, not-applicable, withheld and evidence-gap states are field presence. Listed in M1 Inputs.
CORE-20 and CORE-21 reference the semantic hash, and DATA-21 pins a semantic digest per table at W4. Landing it later guarantees two competing hash implementations. See amendment A2.
The Hypothesis strategy library is co-designed with the domain models; CORE-14..31 all carry property verification. See amendment A1.
Hypothesis dev/ci/deep profiles are pure configuration and must exist before the first property test. See amendment A1.
EngineeringQualificationArtifact carries W0's own Ruff/Pyrefly/lock evidence; left in M6 every earlier wave emits unstructured static-check evidence. See amendment A1.
One Python project, lock and environment is a boundary enforced from the first commit, not retrofitted. See amendment A3.
Notion/Git/Delta/Dropbox ownership is a workspace boundary guarded from the start. See amendment A3.

evidence_extensions.note: Manifest declares projection, render and validation digest fields as optional and empty at W4; PROJ-41 populates them at W8. Declaring them late would force a DATA-56 migration.
Milestone archive writer ships at W4 with an empty outputs section; W8 fills it without a format change.
W3 seeds Arrow-only compatibility cases; W4 owns the matrix; W9 proves both platforms.
Requirement-evidence report emitted from W0 onward; both-platform provenance proven by PROJ-42 and CORE-67 at W9.
W7b must write a provenance row at first vendor invocation; W8's PROJ-40 is a completeness check over rows W7b already produced.

deferred_acceptance.reason: docs/contracts/core.md defers 100% strict public-API coverage to 'after interface stabilization'. W0 delivers the coverage measurement and a non-decreasing ratchet.
Protocols exchange typed DTOs that do not exist until W1-W4. W0 delivers an exhaustive Protocol registry; each later wave fills its own signature.
Advanced Pydantic patterns appear in W1 and W2. W0 seeds the Pyrefly/Pydantic qualification harness; W1 and W2 extend it.

milestone_amendments.change: Required outputs gain CORE-45 and CORE-47..CORE-52 and CORE-66; M6 retains CORE-46 and CORE-67.
Required outputs gain DATA-27, the versioned canonical semantic hash.
Inputs gain DATA-01, DATA-02, DATA-31, DATA-32, DATA-33, DATA-35 and DATA-36.
Inputs gain DATA-46..DATA-50; release-scoped DataFusion contexts and query recipes are M3 work currently swallowed only by the broad M2 DATA-39..60 range.
